# Get access token from login result
access_token = login_result['access_token']

# Get transactions received this month (May 2023)
received_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction='received',
        min_created_at='2023-05-01',
        max_created_at='2023-05-31',
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
        print("Error:", page)
        break
    if not page:
        break
    received_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Received transactions count:", len(received_transactions))
for t in received_transactions:
    print(t)
